criteria.evidence: All five frames name a variant, exclusions, an applicability boundary and a source-scope caution, and none treats product topology or a catalog label as authority (p14 frame and u05 explicitly reject 1fd01bc; p14 runtime actions cite it only as implementation evidence). The criterion still fails on pins. p03's anchors are heading descriptions that do not match the article's numbered sections. p14.move.conclude cites chapter 10, which lies outside its frozen range. p02.move.interpret_report cites ICH E9 §5.6 (multiplicity adjustment) for reporting, and E9 §7 (reporting) is not pinned. p01's PRISMA pin skips items 14-15. Confirmed by web check: Baker et al., JEL 64(2) 2026, 498-557, DOI 10.1257/jel.20251650, exists on aeaweb.org; arXiv 2503.13323v3 numbers its sections 3 (2x2), 4 (covariates), 5.1 (2xT event studies), 5.2 (staggered) and 6 (conclusion). The Schneider and Wagemann chapter-to-topic mapping could not be checked against the publisher's contents (HTTP 403).

All five methods have phases, moves and actions, typed slots, topology with prohibited cycles and edges, honest refusal terminals, and four-status uncertainty. The structural check fails with 7 errors (an action receipt typed as an input with role 'trace' in p02, p03, p04 and p14). Analytic operations are hidden inside broad moves: p01 certainty and missing-evidence assessment, p03 covariates and conditional parallel trends, p14 search execution. In p01 and p14, prohibited edges share endpoints with permitted edges. Loops that p04's own records name are missing from its topology. No execution action is presented as a method-owned warrant: each action's method_owned_rule disclaims the judgment.
